initial_error: Energy inversion stopped at an attained residual of exactly -2 erg/g after 15 iterations; the code used a strict residual <2 erg/g condition.
local_stopping_rule: Residual <= max(2 erg/g, 32 binary64 ulps of the target energy, 1e-8 times the local energy change). Record the actual defect. This is an attainable-resolution stopping rule, not exact conservation.
unchanged_acceptance_gate: The whole-star GR energy defect must still be below 1e-6 of the integrated absolute nuclear rest release. All local inverse errors remain part of that defect.
evidence: first-evolution-failure.log and the saved input/native state reproduce the failing call. The producer snapshot predates this stopping-rule correction.
